levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر بن جامع الحميري

notes: «(3)» and «(1)» are reference numbers, not names: left out.
«عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد» sits inside the chain after «عن»: narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
«عن أبيه» and «عن جده» are bare relations (rule 7). The last link is the grandfather, who is named only by relation.
